name: Villavaquerín (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red by an embattled line, the white charged with a black bull.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 14 July 2000 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 22 August 2000; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes interlocking, white with a black bull at the hoist and red at the fly.
